label: Recording stopped part-day
rule: Records in 5–11 hours, with a stop hour or ≥6 consecutive empty hours

label: Some lanes silent
rule: ≥1 lane below 5% and ≥1 lane at or above 50% of its baseline

label: Plate recognition degraded
rule: Unreadable-plate share ≥0.10 above baseline, and ratio ≥0.20

label: All lanes very low
rule: Ratio <0.05, records in ≥12 hours, no lane split or recognition spike
